# openmetadata_test_definition (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata test definition by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_test_definition" "table_row_count" {
  fully_qualified_name = "customTableRowCount"
}

output "table_row_count_test_definition_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_test_definition.table_row_count.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Test definition fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Test definition UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `data_quality_dimension` (String) Data quality dimension the test measures.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `entity_type` (String) Entity the test runs against: TABLE or COLUMN.
- `name` (String) Test definition name.
- `source` (String) Who owns the definition: automation, system, or user.
- `sql_expression` (String) SQL the platform runs for the definition.
- `supported_data_types` (List of String) Column data types the test supports.
- `supported_services` (List of String) Service types the test supports.
- `test_platforms` (List of String) Test platforms that can execute the definition.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
